liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2026}} to {{cash_like@FY2026}}, equal to cash liquidity to revenue of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2026}}, up {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2026}} on the prior year.

Debt due within one year fell by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2026}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2026}}, so cash on the balance sheet covers the near-term maturities without new funding, and the group repaid its eurobond out of free cash during the year.

Free cash flow after lease payments rose by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2026}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2026}}, lifting FCF after leases to debt by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2026}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2026}}, the measure that leaves lease payments in financing cash flows.

Customer prepayments remain a large part of the funding base: contract liabilities rose by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2026}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2026}}, with advance ticket cover at {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2026}}.

watch_items.text: Leverage: net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2026}} is above the peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2026}} and ranks last of the group ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2026}}), so the balance sheet remains the weakest part of the profile.

Cash generation: FCF to debt slipped by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2026}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2026}}, below the peer median of {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@FY2026}}, as capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2026}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2026}}.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2026}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2026}}, above the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@FY2026}} and the weakest of the group ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@FY2026}}), so a larger share of liquidity is refundable if bookings slow.
Costs: CASK ex-fuel rose by {{cask_ex_fuel.change@FY2026}} to {{cask_ex_fuel@FY2026}} while the GTF engine issue continued to ground aircraft and weigh on utilisation and cost performance.
